sections.title: The Tale Vault
sections.subtitle: Every volume is a standalone experience. Curated collections of flash-fiction comics designed to challenge, inspire, and resonate.

editions.title: Tales 'N' Tells
editions.description: Within this volume, you will witness; an epic lie, a sumptuous chicken, divine fury, the philosophy of the human condition and moral conflict.

editions.title: Tales 'N' Tells Mini
editions.description:
For Kids!!!
Within this volume, you will discover, A Queen's Enduring Legacy, An Obsolete Savior and The High Price of a Tall Tale. This is not just a collection of quick reads. This is a spark for imagination.

editions.title: QUICK HITS: NOIR
editions.description: Dark. Gritty. Uncompromising. A collection of micro-narratives set in shadowed cities and morally ambiguous spaces.

editions.title: FLASH: MIDNIGHT
editions.description: A standalone micro-narrative. Pure storytelling in its most concentrated form.

sections.title: New editions
sections.body: Subscribe to stay updated on new releases, exclusive previews, and behind-the-scenes creator insights.
